title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Settling Amendment Fees on the Account
content:
## What this governs

For Dangerous Goods Acceptance, the amendment fee is settled a single time for each chargeable amendment declaration the shipper has signed, and it is settled on the acceptance that declaration amends. Each chargeable amendment is booked as one amendment-fee entry on the acceptance's dangerous-goods account, referring to that amendment submission. An amendment that costs nothing leaves no entry on the account. The effect visible afterwards is the new amendment-fee entry, dated on the day it is booked, and a correspondingly higher balance owed on the acceptance.

## The booking action: `book_dg_amendment_fee_40feddd0`

**Capability.** One call places one amendment-fee charge on the dangerous-goods account of an acceptance and raises the charges the acceptance owes by that amount. The action itself chooses the declaration the charge attaches to: the most recently signed amendment declaration of that acceptance to which no amendment-fee charge yet refers, and, between two signed at the same moment, the one with the higher declaration reference. It writes that declaration's reference on the charge and returns it. Declarations awaiting signature, returned for correction or withdrawn are never chosen. When a charge with the same acceptance, booking, attached declaration and amount already exists, the call adds nothing and the balance does not move.

**Invocation.** The action is kept hidden from the desk's standing tool list; the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then runs it through `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `dg_id` | reference of the dangerous-goods acceptance whose declaration was amended, as the acceptance lookup shows it | identifier |
| `booking_id` | reference of the booking under which the goods travel, as it appears on the acceptance record | identifier |
| `amount_usd` | the amendment fee to be booked | US dollars with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent beforehand |

**Receipt.** A successful call returns `dg_event_id` (the new charge's reference), `dg_id`, `submission_id` (the signed amendment declaration the charge was attached to; empty when every signed amendment already has a charge), `charge_code` with the value `amendment_fee`, `amount_usd` as booked, and `charges_due_usd`, the balance of dangerous-goods charges still owed on the acceptance once the fee is in.
